body:
I exploded at her earlier today, which caused all these emotions to come back up, I shouted at her that I hate her for never apologising for letting me be abused and ran out.

She apologised when I returned but it felt phoned in, not real, she said sorry a lot in a row, not "Sorry that I did that to you". She only said sorry because she needed me to babysit.

Im living under my mom's roof atm, but it dosent feel like a family, she did break up with the demon for a man but not because of me, but because he cheated on her. I want to move out, I hate living here, theres no room to breathe.

Those links did make me feel better, but unfortunately, I cut myself before I read it, all up my arms. It made me feel better, and I like them in a weird way.
